'''March 2001 Rochester, Minnesota tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, Minnesota on 24 March 2001. [[Andrew Stenson]] won it. It is known from Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1947">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01d1947/ rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01d1947/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Rochester, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Stenson]]
